nodes.label: AGENTS.md Project Engineering Guidelines
nodes.community_name: Enemy AI, Orders and Fog Design Spec

nodes.label: Data-oriented ECS Architecture
nodes.rationale: Gameplay entities (units, factories, projectiles, bases) are composed from data components processed by focused systems with explicit update ordering; keeps gameplay independent of rendering and testable without WebGL.

nodes.label: UI and ECS Boundary
nodes.rationale: Menus and UI state stay outside the ECS; UI issues commands and subscribes to notifications, never mutating ECS internals directly.

nodes.label: Rendering Engine Independence
nodes.rationale: Gameplay modules must not import Three.js or Babylon.js so a future Babylon.js migration only adapts the rendering layer; migration is never assumed automatic.

nodes.label: Rendering Adapter
nodes.rationale: Small interfaces isolate real engine-dependent operations (model loading, visual transforms, effects); no universal engine abstraction.

nodes.label: Babylon.js Migration Candidate
nodes.rationale: Long-term candidate; migration only when explicitly requested or justified by measured requirements.

nodes.label: Fixed-step Simulation with Accumulator
nodes.rationale: Simulation is decoupled from frame rate, with clamped deltas and bounded catch-up so background pauses do not produce huge steps.

nodes.label: Mobile Performance Requirements
nodes.rationale: Mobile is the primary target: 60 FPS on capable devices, stable 30 FPS on minimum devices, validated on real hardware rather than assumed.

nodes.label: Fewer than 100 Draw Calls Target
nodes.rationale: A profiling goal, not a correctness rule; maintainability and visual correctness are not sacrificed solely to meet it.

nodes.label: InstancedMesh and Object Pooling
nodes.rationale: Reuse geometries/materials and instance repeated objects (soldiers, bullets) to reduce draw calls and avoid hot-loop allocations.

nodes.label: Streak System Separated from Rewards
nodes.rationale: Tracking events, streak progress, unlocking, activation validation, effect execution and UI are distinct responsibilities; rewards are not hardcoded into combat.

nodes.label: Performance Monitoring and Device Testing
nodes.rationale: Development builds expose FPS, draw calls, triangles, geometries, entity counts and per-system ECS timing; desktop emulation is not a substitute for real devices.
nodes.community_name: Enemy AI, Orders and Fog Design Spec

nodes.label: TypeScript-only Application Source
nodes.rationale: All web/src code must be strict TypeScript without any; legacy JS migrated incrementally.

nodes.label: Typed ECS World (game/ecs)
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for gameplay state; fixed step updates targeting, movement, weapons, production, resources and projectiles in that order.

nodes.label: Keep Custom ECS instead of bitECS
nodes.rationale: For tens of units the compact typed ECS suffices; the measured bottleneck was rendering (per-soldier objects and draw calls), so switching ECS would not have helped. Instancing addressed the real cause.
nodes.norm_label: keep custom ecs instead of bitecs

nodes.label: Barracks Single-order Production Queue
nodes.rationale: Each explicit request produces one unit (2 s rifleman, 5 s tank), gold is deducted on acceptance; no automatic production or free deployments.

nodes.label: DecisionClock
nodes.rationale: At most one AI decision per frame, driven by game time.

nodes.label: Shared Game Commands (game/commands)
nodes.rationale: Player and AI use the same commands; each validates everything before its first write so a rejection changes nothing.

nodes.label: buildStructure
nodes.rationale: The only gameplay path that creates structures, enforced by a boundary test.

nodes.label: activateReward
nodes.rationale: Validates, targets, charges CP and gold, sets 15 s cooldown and shield, schedules strike in MatchState.strikes; air strike requires caller heading.

nodes.label: Mirrored Placement Zone Rules
nodes.rationale: 5 <= |z| <= 73 on own half, |x| <= 53, minimum distance 3.8 to any own structure including the Nexus.

nodes.label: Nexus Shield Rule (shield.ts)
nodes.rationale: Single place where the shield reduces Nexus damage; artillery and air strike never target the Nexus, so the shield does not reduce their damage. R5 preserves this; balance may be revisited separately.

nodes.label: DeathResolver
nodes.rationale: Once per frame scores each death once, removes entities, emits ordered events and detects victory/defeat (simultaneous Nexus deaths = defeat); terminal result stops processing.

nodes.label: Strike Timeline (scheduleStrike / advanceStrikes)
nodes.rationale: Artillery and air strikes run on game clock in the domain, once per frame between simulation and deaths, only in PLAYING; emits presentation-only events.

nodes.label: legacyRewardTimeline Reference Tests
nodes.rationale: Domain strike execution compared to a transcription of the previous version across 14 scenarios and 6 delta sequences; test utilities are excluded from the production build by an import-walk test.

nodes.label: Structure Definitions Table (definitions/structures.ts)
nodes.rationale: Single source of cost and health for Generators, Barracks, Turrets and Nexus, used by ECS, player, AI and UI.

nodes.label: RewardEffectsView
nodes.rationale: Draws shells, plane and bombs reading only MatchState.strikes; applies no damage and frees meshes when a strike ends or the match unmounts.

nodes.label: Bounded Combat Effect Pools
nodes.source_location: Regresión de congelaciones por efectos de combate
nodes.rationale: Freezes were caused by explosions creating many meshes/materials and unbounded smoke emitters; fixed with InstancedMesh batches and limits (512 particles, 12 emitters, 32 shockwaves, 8 lights, 128 projectiles, 64 debris groups).

nodes.label: Diagnostics Panel (?diagnostics=1)
nodes.rationale: Dev-only; Vite strips the panel, scenarios and metrics store from production builds.

nodes.label: Render Dominates Combat Cost
nodes.rationale: 9-16 ms render CPU and 200-317 draw calls in combat, above the <100 target; ECS simulation is only 0.5-0.9 ms.

nodes.label: Non-shared Health Bar and Tank/Building Meshes

nodes.label: Samsung Galaxy A05 Preliminary Readings
nodes.rationale: Entry-level Mali-G52 phone does not reach 30 FPS even with ~30 entities; readings taken under low battery and tethering, not a definitive reference.

nodes.label: Galaxy A05 Bottleneck Experiment (dpr, shockwaves, smoke, blur, bars)
nodes.rationale: No single toggle explains the ~33-36 ms fixed cost; only resolution moved frame time clearly; draw-call hypothesis not confirmed as primary cause; likely overall CPU-bound plus vsync rounding. Diagnosis closed by user decision.
nodes.norm_label: galaxy a05 bottleneck experiment (dpr, shockwaves, smoke, blur, bars)

nodes.label: Run-to-run Timing Variance Lesson
nodes.rationale: Absolute timings vary up to 2x between runs on this machine; structural metrics (draw calls, geometries, AI rate) are reliable, timings need at least three runs at idle.

nodes.label: Per-phase Comparisons R1-R5
nodes.rationale: Each phase showed no structural change; R2 verified AI drop from 2 to 1 call per frame with 1.40 decisions/s preserved.

nodes.label: Plan: Menú inicial, acordeón de Recompensas y pantalla final
nodes.norm_label: plan: menu inicial, acordeon de recompensas y pantalla final

nodes.label: Spanish Reward Names
nodes.rationale: Reward titles (Bombardeo de artillería, Ataque aéreo, Escudo defensivo) move to Spanish in REWARD_DEFINITIONS, unlocks.json and toasts.

nodes.label: uiIcons (UiIconId, uiIconMarkup, createUiIcon)
nodes.rationale: Single SVG icon set usable both as template strings and DOM elements, viewBox 24x24, aria-hidden.

nodes.label: getRewardFacts
nodes.rationale: Derives reward card facts from getStrikePattern impacts and getRewardDefinitionForDifficulty damage/reduction/duration so the UI never hardcodes balance values; replaces deprecated getRewardEffect.

nodes.label: ScrollCues / getScrollCueState
nodes.rationale: Pure getScrollCueState (threshold 4px) is testable; the ScrollCues class wires scroll + ResizeObserver so cues recompute on rotation/resize and after refresh().

nodes.label: Golden Rewards Accordion (RECOMPENSAS DE COMBATE)
nodes.rationale: Main menu details/summary accordion with reward hexes, cost cards and glowing scroll cues; DESPLEGAR button must stay inside the viewport on 360x640 to 1024x768.

nodes.label: CountUpAnimator
nodes.rationale: Cancellable count-up with injectable FrameScheduler so tests advance time manually; second start cancels the first; reduced motion writes final values immediately.

nodes.label: parseClockDuration / formatClockDuration
nodes.rationale: Accepts mm:ss including >99 minutes; unparseable strings return null and are shown verbatim to avoid NaN.

nodes.label: Compact Game Over Battle Report
nodes.rationale: INFORME DE BATALLA with four icon rows, animated count-up and damage bar; must never need scrolling in any supported orientation.

nodes.label: Main-menu and Game-over CSS Extraction
nodes.rationale: style.css has overlapping layers; menu and game-over styles move to independent sheets (styles/main-menu.css, styles/game-over.css) imported after style.css.

nodes.label: prefers-reduced-motion Handling
nodes.rationale: No sweep, no pulse, instant count and instant scroll; JS checks matchMedia in addition to the global CSS rule.

nodes.label: Plan: R2 — Fase 1 de la IA enemiga
nodes.norm_label: plan: r2 — fase 1 de la ia enemiga
nodes.community_name: Enemy AI, Orders and Fog Design Spec

nodes.label: EnemyAiProfile / ENEMY_AI_PROFILES
nodes.rationale: Deep-frozen per-difficulty decision parameters (intervals 1.25/0.7/0.35 s, targets, build chances, zones, reward preference) that preserve current values exactly.

nodes.label: DecisionClock
nodes.rationale: Accumulator that subtracts the interval (keeps remainder instead of resetting to 0), at most one decision per call, remainder clamped to half an interval so a slow frame or huge delta never causes a burst; only counts gameplay delta, so pauses add no time.

nodes.label: Double updateEnemyAI Execution Fix
nodes.rationale: animate called runEnemyAIUpdate twice per frame; isolated commit keeps a single call; expected Normal rate shifts from 1.40 to ~1.43 decisions/s because the old code lost the remainder.

nodes.label: decideEnemyTurn
nodes.rationale: Pure decision from an EnemyAiSnapshot returning commands and a status; reproduces updateEnemyAI and maybeActivateEnemyReward including the order and count of random draws; at most one build per turn.

nodes.label: EnemyAiSnapshot
nodes.rationale: Flat read-only summary (gold, structure counts, idle factories, CP, cooldown, shield, targets, nexus health) so the AI never reads ECS or render objects directly.

nodes.label: EnemyAiCommand (build / train / activateReward)
nodes.rationale: The AI only emits orders; it never writes components, wallets, health, render objects or UI.

nodes.label: EnemyAiController
nodes.rationale: Per-match glue: rolls targets on creation, owns a DecisionClock and reads the snapshot only when a decision is due.

nodes.label: sequenceRng (scripted test RNG)
nodes.rationale: Throws when asked for more values than scripted, so an extra or missing Math.random silently changing behavior fails the tests.

nodes.label: Projected Gold Within a Turn
nodes.rationale: Construction reduces the gold seen by training, and training reduces the gold seen by rewards; rifleman orders without gold are still emitted and rejected by the ECS (faithful to legacy, flagged as weak by the audit).

nodes.label: executeEnemyAiTurn / buildEnemyAiSnapshot (GameApplication, R2)
nodes.rationale: View-side executor that maps commands to spendFactionGold+spawnAIBuilding, requestUnitProduction and activateRewardForFaction; later replaced in R4.

nodes.label: Plan: R3 — Capa de partida independiente
nodes.norm_label: plan: r3 — capa de partida independiente
nodes.community_name: Enemy AI, Orders and Fog Design Spec

nodes.label: MatchState
nodes.rationale: Holds only CP, kill streaks, counters and the terminal outcome; the ECS remains the single source of truth for health and entity lifecycle.

nodes.label: DeathResolver
nodes.rationale: Once-per-frame pass over World entities with health, updates MatchState, removes dead entities and returns ordered events plus outcome; reuses scratch arrays across frames; no-op once outcome is set.

nodes.label: MatchEvent / DeathResolution
nodes.rationale: unitDied and structureDestroyed events in processing order; outcomeIsNew reported once.

nodes.label: unlockEventsFor
nodes.rationale: Translates match events into the existing unlocks.recordEvent calls (unit_killed, kill_streak, achievement destroy_20_units).

nodes.label: Death Processing Order
nodes.rationale: Player units, then enemy units, then player structures (Nexus included), then enemy structures; newest to oldest within each group — preserves legacy kill-streak semantics.

nodes.label: Combat Point Values
nodes.rationale: Soldier 1, tank 3, turret 4, generator 4, barracks 6, Nexus 0, awarded to the opposite faction via getCombatPointsFor.

nodes.label: Simultaneous Nexus Fall Is Defeat
nodes.rationale: If both Nexus die in the same frame the result is defeat; outcome is terminal.

nodes.label: legacyDeathReference (temporary transcription)
nodes.rationale: Literal transcription of GameApplication.ts @ 5b988a8 death logic used to prove equivalence, deleted in Tarea 4.

nodes.label: MatchHarness
nodes.rationale: Test harness running 'legacy' or 'current' processors over a BattleSimulation and producing comparable FrameResults.

nodes.label: deathResolver Differential Test
nodes.rationale: Seeded mulberry32 random battles (100 per difficulty, up to 400 frames) compare legacy vs current frame-by-frame with 0 differences required; proves behavior identical before deleting old logic.

nodes.label: setNexusHealth (dev diagnostic)
nodes.rationale: Development-only diagnostic writing ECS base health to force victory or defeat.

nodes.label: Plan: R4 — Comandos compartidos
nodes.community_name: Enemy AI, Orders and Fog Design Spec

nodes.label: CommandContext / checkMatchPlaying
nodes.rationale: Context (world, bases, MatchState, sessionPhase, difficulty, clock) rebuilt on every call; a command is accepted only with PLAYING and no outcome, rejecting with match-over (priority) or not-playing before any other check; no stored isPlaying flag.

nodes.label: validatePlacement / BUILD_ZONE / MIN_STRUCTURE_SPACING
nodes.rationale: Inclusive zones (player 5..73 z, |x|<=53; enemy mirrored) and 3.8 minimum spacing against own buildings including the Nexus; order zone, then distance, then gold; same rule for player and AI.

nodes.label: buildStructure / sellStructure
nodes.rationale: Validate everything before writing: checkMatchPlaying, validatePlacement, gold, trySpendResources, createBuildableStructure; sell refunds floor(cost*0.7).

nodes.label: createBuildableStructure
nodes.rationale: The ECS entity is born from the validated command; constructionBoundary test forbids structure creation outside initialBattle, structureCommands and diagnosticStructures.

nodes.label: placeDiagnosticStructure (dev only)
nodes.rationale: Throws unless import.meta.env.DEV, so diagnostic out-of-zone structures disappear from the production bundle.

nodes.label: FactionRewardState (match.rewards)
nodes.rationale: Per-faction cooldownUntilMs and shieldUntilMs inside MatchState so cooldown and shield never leak into the next match.

nodes.label: applyFactionShield / applyRewardDamage (single shield path)
nodes.rationale: One shield path for projectile and reward damage; fixes double reduction (x0.5 not x0.25).

nodes.label: activateReward / rewardTargetCandidates
nodes.rationale: Rejection order: insufficient-points, insufficient-gold, no-valid-target/shield-active, cooldown; all checks before the first write; 15000 ms per-faction cooldown (REWARD_COOLDOWN_MS).

nodes.label: buildEnemyAiSnapshot (domain, aiSnapshot.ts)
nodes.rationale: Builds the AI snapshot from the ECS and match.rewards instead of view state.

nodes.label: executeEnemyTurn
nodes.rationale: Domain executor so the comparison test exercises real code; GameApplication only represents accepted outcomes; the AI does not react to rejections.

nodes.label: runAiMatch / aiMatchRunner
nodes.rationale: Headless seeded match runner replicating animate order (clock, AI turn, simulation.advance, DeathResolver) and collecting AiRunMetrics.

nodes.label: LEGACY_STRATEGY (legacyEnemyExecutor)
nodes.rationale: Transcription of GameApplication @ bf2c4a7 executor pinned with a seeded BASELINE before touching production, to separate the new spacing rule's effect from accidental changes.

nodes.label: Command Atomicity

nodes.label: StrikeTimeline (MatchState.strikes)
nodes.rationale: Strike timeline lives in the match domain so artillery and air-strike damage no longer depend on Three.js animation (approach A1: replicate current frame arithmetic).

nodes.label: scheduleStrike
nodes.rationale: Places artillery shells (launchAt 0.7+i*0.7, flight 2.2 s) or the air run (aim -/+ heading*60); freezes a copy of the heading; sets strikeActiveUntilMs now+4300 / now+5200; throws for air strike without heading.

nodes.label: advanceStrikes
nodes.rationale: Called once per frame in PLAYING between advanceBattleSimulation and updateCombat with the same delta as gameplayClockMs; fixes float operation order for strict equality; no-op after outcome; sorts due impacts by nominal time, strike id, index.

nodes.label: StrikeEvent
nodes.rationale: Presentation events (shell-launched, bomb-released, impact, strike-finished) translated by GameApplication into explosions, sound and haptics.

nodes.label: isStrikeTarget
nodes.rationale: Targetable enemy-faction entity alive with position and never a Nexus, so the shield never affects strike damage.

nodes.label: Air/Artillery Strike Constants and ENEMY_AIR_STRIKE_HEADING
nodes.rationale: AIR_STRIKE_FLIGHT_SECONDS 5.2, RUN_HALF_LENGTH 60, SPEED 120/5.2, BOMB_FALL 0.72, enemy heading {-1,0}; moved from GameApplication to rewardSystem.ts.

nodes.label: nominalBombLandingSeconds
nodes.rationale: Only for framing the camera; impact order does not use it.

nodes.label: Nominal Impact Time Ordering
nodes.rationale: nominalMs = frameStart + (threshold - counterBefore)*1000, never from startedAtMs, so a player activation between frames and an AI activation inside the same frame order identically.

nodes.label: Clock Option A (per-frame gameplay clock)
nodes.rationale: Strikes advance with gameplayClockMs and the frame delta, not the fixed step, keeping impacts on the same frames as the legacy view-driven code.

nodes.label: LegacyRewardTimeline
nodes.rationale: Transcription of GameApplication.ts @ f54dc77 (blob 9bff6f4, identical in 71890e9) strike code with visuals removed, pinned before production changes.

nodes.label: strikeScenarios / runStrikeScenario / StrikeDriver (S1–S11)
nodes.rationale: Replays animate order over game-time scenario steps with legacy and domain drivers; 14 scenarios x 6 delta sequences must match strictly; the test is never relaxed.

nodes.label: DELTA_SEQUENCES
nodes.rationale: fixed60, fixed30, clamp, jitter (seededRng(5)), paused, huge — each covering at least 8 s of gameplay.

nodes.label: onImpactApplied Test Hook
nodes.rationale: Optional inert parameter kept in production; when omitted no hit arrays are allocated and damage is identical.

nodes.label: RewardEffectsView
nodes.rationale: Three.js view that syncs visuals from StrikeTimeline by strike id, never applies damage, does not read the camera, clears on teardown and disposes shared geometry/material.

nodes.label: testUtilitiesBoundary Import-Graph Test
nodes.rationale: Walks relative imports from main.ts and fails if test utilities are reachable, proving they are excluded from the Vite bundle (identifier grep is unreliable after minification).

nodes.label: Headless Strikes in aiMatchRunner
nodes.rationale: runAiMatch gains strikes/setup options and strikeImpacts/combatPointsSpent metrics; compares cumulative spending rather than CP balance because lethal impacts award CP in the same frame.
